package answer

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// ApplyManualReviewInput holds manual review payload.
type ApplyManualReviewInput struct {
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	ReviewerID          string
	Status              int
	FinalScore          *float64
	Feedback            *string
}

// ApplyManualReview applies reviewer decision.
type ApplyManualReview struct {
	Answers         repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	ManualReviews   repository.ManualReviewRepository
	LearningActions repository.LearningActionLifecycleRepository
	Publisher       domain.EventPublisher
}

// Handle stores manual review and updates status.
func (uc ApplyManualReview) Handle(ctx context.Context, in ApplyManualReviewInput) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview, error) {
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if answer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if existing, err := uc.ManualReviews.GetByAnswerID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID); err == nil && existing != nil {
		answer.Status = existing.Status
		answer.UpdatedAt = existing.CheckedAt
		if err := closeAnswerLearningAction(ctx, uc.LearningActions, uc.Answers, *answer, existing.CheckedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return existing, nil
	} else if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return nil, err
	}
	if in.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed && in.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	review := domain.StudentTaskAnswerReview{
		ID:                  uuid.NewString(),
		StudentTaskAnswerID: in.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		ReviewerID:          in.ReviewerID,
		CheckedAt:           time.Now().UTC(),
		FinalScore:          in.FinalScore,
		Status:              in.Status,
		Feedback:            in.Feedback,
	}
	if err := uc.ManualReviews.Save(ctx, review); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	answer.Status = in.Status
	answer.UpdatedAt = review.CheckedAt
	if err := closeAnswerLearningAction(ctx, uc.LearningActions, uc.Answers, *answer, review.CheckedAt); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if uc.Publisher != nil {
		_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(domain.SubjectTaskAnswerReviewed, map[string]any{
			"student_task_answer_id": in.StudentTaskAnswerID,
			"status":                 in.Status,
		})
	}
	return &review, nil
}
